notes: Refined core logic and test coverage to explicitly include fallback thresholds and separation of unit vs integration validation.

change_log.value: Implement provider search orchestration using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding generation, including explicit fallback trigger thresholds to taxonomy-based search via NUCC codes when vector relevance is below defined cutoff or result set is sparse. Include ranking, deduplication, and multi-stage geographic filtering (FIPS/county resolution).

change_log.note: Separate unit vs integration coverage and expand edge cases

stories.title: Provider Search Input/Output Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define and validate request/response schema for provider search including free-text query, normalized location inputs (state/city/zip → county), specialty filters (NUCC codes), and structured result payload (provider identity, location, specialty match, relevance score). Ensure strict Pydantic validation and compatibility with facade contract.

stories.title: Core Provider Search Logic (Vector + Taxonomy Fallback)
stories.description: Implement provider search orchestration using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding generation, including explicit fallback trigger thresholds to taxonomy-based search via NUCC codes when vector relevance is below defined cutoff or result set is sparse. Include ranking, deduplication, and multi-stage geographic filtering (FIPS/county resolution).

stories.title: Find Care Facade Integration with Specialty Resolution
stories.description: Integrate provider search into FindCare facade, including coordination with specialty_service for dual-pipeline specialty identification (regex + vector) and passing resolved NUCC codes into search. Ensure orchestration aligns with tool_router expectations and chat-driven workflows.

stories.title: Provider Search API and Tool Exposure
stories.description: Expose provider search via FastAPI and tool_router as an allowlisted tool, ensuring validated inputs, structured outputs, error handling, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use flow. Include logging hooks for debug_logger.

stories.title: Provider Search Tests and End-to-End Validation
stories.description: Implement unit tests (schema validation, embedding generation, fallback threshold logic, ranking/deduplication) and integration tests (end-to-end vector search, taxonomy fallback activation, specialty integration, API/tool_router flow). Validate behavior under sparse data, ambiguous queries, and degraded embedding responses.
